title: Feedback in the leader's wedge

complaints.says: There's a loud squeal every time I step up to the mic!

win.label: Leader still hears themselves in Wedge 1

hints: Feedback is a loop: the mic hears the wedge, which plays the mic. What's pushing that loop too hard?
cause: Vox 1's send to the leader's wedge and the wedge's own volume were both turned way up, so the mic was hearing itself louder than the singer.
lesson: Fix feedback by turning down that mic in that wedge's mix (or the wedge's volume) — not by muting the singer. Point mics away from wedges.
